Spread within a team: who carries each skill?

Source: R/players.R
plot_spread.Rd

One row per variable, players as dots (size = volume, e.g. attempts), the team's weighted average as a line, and the coefficient of variation written at the end. Players named in label_top are labelled at their dots.

Usage

plot_spread(
  data,
  made,
  attempts,
  labels = made,
  player = "player",
  shrink = TRUE,
  min_attempts = 1,
  label_top = 3,
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL,
  caption = NULL
)

Arguments

data

Player rows for one team.

made, attempts

Character vectors of paired columns (e.g. c("p2m", "p3m", "ftm") and c("p2a", "p3a", "fta")).

labels

Row labels.

player

Column with names.

shrink

Shrink percentages.

min_attempts

Players with fewer attempts of a kind are left out of that row.

label_top

Number of highest-volume players to name per row.

title, subtitle, caption

Labels.

Details

With shrink = TRUE and made/attempts pairs, percentages are shrunk (see shrink_rate()) so a 0/2 shooter no longer defines the range.

Examples

okc <- subset(box_score(pbp_games), team == "OKC" & min >= 10)
plot_spread(okc, c("p2m", "p3m", "ftm"), c("p2a", "p3a", "fta"),
            labels = c("2-point FG%", "3-point FG%", "Free throws"))
